description: Full probes: carrier, reader, controls and paired intervals. Every slot and seed for both carriers and readout families in r8/r10; 512 held-out board identities per cell. r8 historical heldout fields retain their saved five-decimal precision; raw-only outline endpoints use the ledger's unrounded fields. Gain intervals are paired board-bootstrap intervals, not endpoint intervals or seed variation. Rare r10 values remain outside registered readability support; see the per-value coverage table. MLP fits have a fixed budget, not a solver-convergence assessment. Analytical reduction only; exact per-cell and per-update rows remain released. Printed sum-reader ranges retain seed identities; category readers remain in the detailed file. Gain CI envelopes span the five saved slot intervals and are not new confidence intervals. Floor ranges span seeds and slots. Detailed records: paper/data/release/appendix_E_probes.json.gz (schema and SHA-256 in release/index.json).
